products.text:
Type: flatwoven diamond area rug
Use: defining a seating or reading area; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: modern, contemporary, bohemian
Materials: flatwoven fibers, low flat weave
Colors: slate blue, light grey, mustard gold accents
Shape: rectangular, central field of small intersecting diamonds fading into speckled grey edges, flat and thin, medium size
Feel: textured, relaxed, lively
Goes with: light wood floors, white or teal walls, brass accents; modern or eclectic rooms

Type: geometric area rug
Use: anchoring a chair or seating area; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: contemporary, modern, coastal
Materials: tufted pile, watercolor-dyed yarn
Colors: bright cobalt blue, ivory
Shape: rectangular, bold interlocking zigzag maze stripes with a hand-painted watercolor effect, low pile, medium size
Feel: bold, fresh, energetic
Goes with: dark wood floors, yellow or white furniture, black accents; modern or coastal rooms

Type: abstract flatwoven rug
Use: accenting a floor area; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: modern, mid-century modern, contemporary
Materials: flatwoven fibers, fringed ends
Colors: cream, warm grey, charcoal, teal, orange accent
Shape: rectangular, cubist-inspired blocks of triangles and angled shapes, short fringe on both ends, thin and flat, medium size
Feel: artistic, playful, graphic
Goes with: light wood floors, teal or white walls, orange accents; modern or mid-century rooms

Type: vintage damask area rug
Use: anchoring a sofa area; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: traditional, classic, contemporary
Materials: low-pile woven fibers, distressed finish
Colors: warm grey, ivory
Shape: rectangular, all-over faded damask scroll pattern, low flat pile, medium-large
Feel: soft, elegant, calm
Goes with: taupe sofas, dark wood floors, cream upholstery; classic or transitional rooms

Type: distressed handtufted area rug
Use: accenting a floor area; living room, bedroom, entryway
Style: farmhouse, rustic, contemporary

Shape: rectangular, abstract distressed grid pattern, low soft pile, compact
Feel: warm, light, organic
Goes with: natural wood, brick or terracotta floors, white walls, green plants; farmhouse or rustic rooms

Type: distressed medallion area rug

Colors: charcoal grey, ivory
Shape: large rectangle, faded medallion and floral motifs with border, plush pile, generous size

Goes with: cognac leather, medium wood floors, neutral walls; transitional or modern rooms

Type: Persian floral runner rug

Style: bohemian, traditional

Colors: deep teal, rust, mustard, red, purple accents
